summary.headline: Kronos with Hermes and Selene
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Hermes traveling with Kronos and Selene traveling with Kronos, including effects of hexagonal, trigonal, and tetragonal configurations on winds, rain, illnesses, magic, political affairs, movement, oaths, testimony, and water supplies.
